text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — we'll be shifting tonight's all-hands 10m later (start 16:10 PT) to give ops time to finish the AV checks. Sorry for the short notice.
Ben: Noted. Is this because of the stream flakiness from last week?
Aisha: Yep, last week's recording dropped twice during demos. Ops found a race between the recorder and slide deck load.
Priya: Can the stream be recorded to S3 only (no live) as a fallback? That'd at least save the recording if the live fails.
Evan: We can toggle recorder fallback — DeployBot just pushed a flag to enable S3 primary. Trying now.
DeployBot: recorder-service: toggling s3_fallback=true for all-hands cluster... SUCCESS (5.2s)
Maya: Awesome. Quick mic check request: any presenters should join 5 mins early to verify push-to-talk and headset routing.
Chris: I'll stay on to test with presenters. @Aisha do we have a list of speakers + join times?
Aisha: Yes — sending schedule in a DM. Main ask: if you have a demo that uses local audio, message @Chris so he can pre-provision an input channel.
Ben: For the agenda — can we add a 5-min Q&A after the roadmap to cover model prioritization? Folks keep pinging me with questions.
Aisha: Good call. We'll fold that in after the roadmap section, 5 minutes. If Qs run over we'll collect remaining in this thread and answer offline.
Priya: Also, recording note for leadership: don't use the "Share computer sound" option in the Zoom slide share — it creates a duplicate audio stream the recorder hates. Use the deck audio channel we provisioned.
Evan: If anyone sees stream buffering during the session, run this quick restart on the recorder host: `ssh ops@recorder-01 'systemctl restart recorder.service'` — but ping #eng-sre first.
Maya: Got it, I'll be on standby.
Chris: Mic tests: @Ben 1) Can you say "redwood inference quick test"?
Ben: redwood inference quick test
Chris: Got you loud/clear on my side.
Aisha: Thanks all. If you have urgent Qs for leadership, drop them here and I'll make sure we cover them in the live Q&A or follow up after. See you in ~10. :slightly_smiling_face:
